customers.evidence: One combined company dedicated to serving investors across every phase of their financial journeys.

community.evidence: We're investing our resources where we can make the most difference in areas that align with our business.

innovation.evidence: Schwab continues to earn high praise for its heritage of innovation

result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual and third-party oriented: metrics, news and awards dominate, with the company referred to in the third person. Customers are addressed first, through a 'exists to help people' mission line. Hedged, first-person 'we believe' appears only in the Careers teaser. Community commitment is brief and conditional on business alignment. No employee, environment or integrity commitments appear.
